name: 01-처음
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); return { 조합: document.getElementById('combo-now').textContent, 벽겹침: hits(), 거실바닥: st().floors['거실'], 아트월: st().artWall } })()

name: 02-위에서보기-가구배치
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); document.getElementById('view-top').click(); return 'top' })()

name: 03-거실-그레이타일-세이지벽
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); document.querySelector('[data-tab=finish]').click(); const s = document.getElementById('finish-room'); s.value = '거실'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); [...document.querySelectorAll('#floor-chips .chip')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('라이트 그레이 타일')).click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('#wall-chips .chip')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('세이지')).click(); return { 거실바닥: st().floors['거실'], 거실벽: st().walls['거실'], 안방바닥: st().floors['안방'], 조합: document.getElementById('combo-now').textContent } })()

name: 04-전체방에적용
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); document.getElementById('apply-all').click(); return Object.entries(st().floors).map(([k, x]) => k + ':' + x + '/' + st().walls[k]).join(', ') })()

name: 05-아트월켜기
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); document.getElementById('art-wall').click(); document.getElementById('view-oblique').click(); v.controls.target.set(-1.0, 1.0, 1.6); v.camera.position.set(1.5, 1.6, 1.6); v.controls.update(); return st().artWall })()

name: 06-소파끌어서-벽에붙이기
dragJs: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, 0.3, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hits = () => [...v.furnitureObjs.keys()].filter(id => v.furnitureObjs.get(id).userData.hitsWall); document.getElementById('view-top').click(); v.controls.update(); const s = st().furniture.sofa; const a = scr(s.at[0], s.at[1]); const b = scr(s.at[0] + 0.6, s.at[1]); return [...a, ...b] })()
